summary: Reviewed all task changes: generated local protocol and help are version/hash bound, schemas establish exact session field requirements but not ownership or model availability, and per-turn overrides persist to subsequent turns. Real fresh controller processes use canonical snapshots and one owned workspace across build/critic/repair, frozen profile drift is rejected and a competing writer lease fails. Native critic read-only arguments are verified without claiming the double enforces an OS sandbox. Persistent-session/subagent adapters are explicitly deferred, and live model proof remains abc-10. 52 relevant tests passed on macOS and Linux, with ordinary clone make and candidate distribution gates.
